C0778.title: Remote Mobile Phone Intrusion via Trojan for Extortion
C0778.summary: In 2018, a criminal gang lured victims into video chats through social apps, sent trojans purchased from abroad under the pretext of software issues, remotely infiltrated victims' phones to harvest contact lists, and recorded explicit videos for extortion. The gang committed dozens of offenses involving over 40,000 yuan.

references.title: He Was Extorted Multiple Times After an Online Flirtatious Chat, Only to Discover the 'Girl' Was Actually a Man When the Suspect Was Caught
